kwargs.profile_path: profile['path'] in audit_surface (Path(get_hermes_home()).absolute()). It MUST be the Hermes HOME ROOT that contains profiles/. When the audited profile is itself a named profile (its path is <home>/profiles/<name>), pass the home root two levels up (Path(p).parent.parent). If the given folder has no profiles/ child but its parent folder is named 'profiles', the section reports status not_measured with reason named_profile_given (never a silent 0 profiles).
kwargs.clock: do not pass (test hook; defaults to time.monotonic)

consequences.profile_duplicates.repeated_binary: An executable file of at least 10 MiB is stored as byte-identical copies in at least three profiles; this measures duplicated disk bytes and does not show whether any profile runs it.
consequences.profile_duplicates.identical_files: Byte-identical non-credential files repeated across profiles take more than 100 MiB beyond one copy each, not counting regenerable caches; this measures redundant storage across profile directories and does not establish which profile copy is authoritative.
consequences.profile_duplicates.cloned_identity_files: Byte-identical MEMORY.md or USER.md files appear in at least three profiles, or more than half of the lines in the median memory file match other profiles; this measures matching content only and cannot tell which copy is the original or how the files came to match.
consequences.profile_duplicates.per_profile_caches: Regenerable hub and model catalog caches repeated across profile directories exceed 50 MiB; this measures disk space used by per-profile cache copies and does not show data corruption.
consequences.profile_duplicates.empty_profiles: At least five profile directories are completely empty or contain only log files; this counts folder contents and does not show whether a gateway still references them.
consequences.profile_duplicates.could_not_verify: Profile duplicate measurements hit a safety bound, symlink exclusion, or read error before all profile entries were verified; partial counts are retained and unverified regions are not claimed clean.

free_strings.what: profiles[].path and cloned_identity.files[].path: absolute path of an existing profile folder <home>/profiles/<name>
free_strings.why_safe: kept unchanged by EvidenceSerializer.scalar (existing absolute path, resolved; the module emits it already resolved); only profiles whose name matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64} are listed, others are only counted in unsafe_profile_name_count; at most max_names_listed (50) profile rows and 150 identity rows

free_strings.what: empty_profiles.paths, log_only_profiles.paths, no_config_profiles.paths, profile_families.families[].paths: absolute profile folder paths
free_strings.why_safe: same rule as path; each list capped at max_names_listed (50), counts carry the full totals

free_strings.what: top_duplicate_groups[].location: absolute path of the first-level folder <home>/profiles/<first member, sorted>/<first path component> where the copies live, or the profile folder for a file in the profile root; null when no member has a safe profile and folder name
free_strings.why_safe: never deeper than one folder inside a profile, never a file; credential-named files are size-only and never located (credential_same_size_groups carry a class label and counts only)

free_strings.what: finding.affected_identities: absolute path of <home>/profiles (or of <home>, or of the named profile folder for named_profile_given); empty list when the given root is missing or not a real folder
free_strings.why_safe: existing absolute folder, kept unchanged; a missing path is left out instead of becoming a per-run token

notes: adapt_component_result keeps run_metrics: every top-level key other than ok/status/error/findings/coverage/classification is copied into the adapted result (contract.py:615-617), so run_metrics and profile_duplicates both pass through. The caller must store run_metrics OUTSIDE canonical_payload (store.finalize_run) so elapsed_ms never enters the digest.

status in the envelope is the legacy 'pass'/'fail' from make_component_envelope; adapt_component_result ignores it (kept as legacy_status_ignored) and 'error' is never returned. coverage is 'verified' or 'could_not_verify' and is honoured by adapt_component_result.
Finding evidence 'pattern' was removed from repeated_binary (persistence.finding_dto would drop a free string evidence key); finding evidence holds numbers and vocabulary only.
kwargs: pass only profile_path. The module never opens config.yaml (size only: it can hold API keys) and needs no config-derived values.

New sealed keys vs the review notes: skipped_credential_dirs (count of credential-classified folders inside profiles that were not walked; not a coverage cut), cache_duplicate_wasted_bytes, wasted_bytes_excluding_caches (identical_files now triggers on this), regenerable_cache (per duplicate group). observation is now the fixed label size_only_not_hashed.

Dict keys SOUL.md / MEMORY.md / USER.md (cloned_identity.by_kind) must be in SCHEMA_KEYS (SOUL.md is already in evidence.VOCABULARY; MEMORY.md and USER.md are not), otherwise _serialize_dict_key replaces them with hmac: keys.
Evidence keys must stay clear of contract._SECRET_KEY_RE (token/secret/credential/...): skipped_credential_dirs is therefore a section key only, never finding evidence.

FREE STRINGS: the section and findings emit NO string that EvidenceSerializer.scalar would tokenise. Every string is either a vocabulary token listed here or the absolute path of an existing folder under the keys path / paths / location (section) and affected_identities / source_paths.path (findings). Proved by test_sealing_round_trip_keeps_everything_with_wiring_sets (every string returned unchanged), test_no_hmac_token_anywhere_in_sealed_output and test_two_runs_on_the_same_home_seal_identically (two runs, each through adapt_component_result + serialize_evidence with a fresh per-run key + persistence.finding_dto, are byte-identical).

Paths must exist at serialisation time (the serializer lstat's them); a profile folder deleted between audit and serialisation would become a token. All emitted paths are built from os.path.realpath(profile_path), so the serializer's resolve() returns them unchanged.

Removed free strings: profile names (now folder paths), duplicate-group patterns (now location + file_kind + numbers), size-only patterns (now file_kind class + suffixed_copy + at_profile_root + counts), family labels and prefixes (now kind + member_count + paths), the <unsafe-name> placeholder (unsafe names are counted, never listed). Removed keys: name, profile, pattern, family, prefix, prefix_families, digit_series_families, empty_profile_count, log_only_profile_count, no_config_profile_count (counts now live in empty_profiles.count etc.).

profile_path must be the Hermes home ROOT that contains profiles/. audit_surface's profile['path'] is Path(get_hermes_home()).absolute(); when HERMES_HOME points at a named profile (.../profiles/<name>) the caller should pass the home root two levels up. If it does not, the module now reports not_measured / named_profile_given (tested) instead of 0 profiles.

Finding evidence source_digest is added by persistence.finding_dto with the active redaction scope's serializer key; it is persistence-owned and outside this module (the two-run test runs unscoped, where that key is process-wide).
